title: Calculus in Anger — Class XII, Chapters 6–9
subject: mathematics
source: Personal study notes from my own Class XII Mathematics revision project (Days 16–26), where each theorem was verified in NumPy/SymPy and mapped onto aerospace, electronics and computing.
summary: The derivative as rate, direction and extreme — including the maximum that hides at an endpoint; integration as a family of curves whose lost constant is a physical measurement; definite integrals read from boundary states, with parity as a free shortcut; and differential equations that describe what is possible until one condition says what happened.
